text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Messiah, smile, smile! It's not 
like you're taking an ID photo.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Um... L-Like this, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that lovely? Come on, Craft, 
Cesario, squeeze in closer. Snug enough 
for a hug, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha, bringing it up again like this is 
actually a little embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But since Heart went out of her way 
to say so... Here goes—*hugs*.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, looking good! Come on Trainer, 
it's a photo op!"
choice_data_list: Alright, taking the picture! Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Daring Heart asked me to be the 
cameraman.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! I want you to take it from that 
angle. Think of it as a casual snapshot, 
capturing a moment from everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—This time, focus mainly on the face, 
please. I want to capture that natural, 
atmospheric presence.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahaha! Come on, Trainer, smile too! We 
want purely fun vibes here, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time we finished the day-long 
photoshoot and returned to the Trainer's 
office, the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for keeping me company 
today! It was a huge help.
choice_data_list: But why take a photo all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sorry, had I not told you yet?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see— I received a fan 
letter from America."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The senders are members from the summer 
camp I took part in back when I was in 
America. They're all precious friends of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was the leader, you know, so everyone 
really looked up to me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“...Even now after I've moved to Japan, 
they're still cheering me on. But—”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. Seeing the high level of 
Japanese races, it seems she's just gotten 
a little worried.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, it can't be helped. After watching 
Craft and the others race, you can't help 
but wonder, 'Can we really win?'

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"As for the race, since winning is the 
only thing that will put their minds at 
ease, let's set that aside for now—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to let you know that I'm 
spending every day happily and having a 
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Tell them their leader is shining just as 
brightly as ever, even in a foreign land.
choice_data_list: Is that why you took a photo?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, never let my cherished people worry. 
For that is the duty of a Queen!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And so, for the last one, would you mind 
helping me take one more important photo?"
choice_data_list:
Sure, but what kind of photos are we 
taking?

Sure, but what kind of photos are you 
going to take?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it won't take much time at all. 
Let's get the happiest two-shot picture 
possible, okay?
